## serp-markup-builder 13.0.0

- Major update: Enhanced documentation and workflow clarity, with comprehensive instructions for both meta tag and schema markup generation.
- Explicit mode selection logic for "meta" (titles/descriptions/social tags) and "schema" (JSON-LD structured data) tasks, including default inference from request nouns.
- Clear scope boundaries: skill handles only document head elements, not body copy or technical SEO diagnostics.
- Output format expectations detailed for both modes—three title/description options and OG/Twitter/canonical/robots block for meta; validated JSON-LD plus guidance for schema.
- Handoff summary and contract requirements specified, ensuring consistent output and next steps for publish-readiness.
- Tiered data sourcing process and strict metric labeling standards now enforced in all outputs.
